description: This file contains a static utility class 'TestingUtils' providing various test-related helper methods for logging configuration, trace file naming, asynchronous predicate waiting, time manipulation, and thread pool configuration within the Orleans testing infrastructure.

classes.name: TestingUtils
classes.description: A static class providing utility methods for testing scenarios in Orleans, including logging setup, trace file creation, predicate waiting, timeout manipulation, and thread pool configuration.

methods.name: ConfigureDefaultLoggingBuilder
methods.description: Configures the logging builder with a file provider that logs to the specified file path.

methods.name: CreateTraceFileName
methods.description: Creates a trace log filename for a specific node and cluster, ensuring the logs directory exists.

methods.name: CreateDefaultLoggerFactory
methods.description: Creates a default logger factory configured with file and console logging, with optional custom filters.

methods.name: WaitUntilAsync
methods.description: Waits asynchronously until a predicate function returns true or a timeout occurs.

methods.name: Multiply
methods.description: Multiplies a TimeSpan by a scalar value, returning the adjusted TimeSpan.

methods.name: ConfigureThreadPoolSettingsForStorageTests
methods.description: Configures ThreadPool and ServicePointManager settings optimized for storage tests.
